description: Propose the written frame of the strategy: why the organization exists (purpose, one text for all its matrices) and, for a matrix, where it wants to be (vision), where it starts from (context) and what it chose and gave up (tradeoffs). Prose, in the words of the leadership, not bullet lines: the lines are the matrix. Ask the person before you write, and write what they said; do not invent a purpose. You write a DRAFT: it becomes the position of the organization only when a person validates it in the app, at the link returned, so give them that link. Each field given replaces, null clears, fields not given are kept. Read the current frame first in get_matrix_data (strategicContext). Vision and purpose are meant to be shared outside once validated; context and tradeoffs stay internal unless visibility says otherwise.

context.description: Where it starts from, what changed, what makes this cycle necessary.

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix whose vision, context and tradeoffs you write (default: the default matrix). Not needed for the purpose alone.

purpose.description: Why the organization exists, written out. It holds across cycles and for every matrix.

purpose_label.description: What the organization calls it: "Purpose", "Mission", "Raison d'être"…

tradeoffs.description: What was chosen, and what was given up.

visibility.description: Per section of the matrix: "shared" may be shown outside once validated, "internal" stays with members. Defaults: vision shared, context and tradeoffs internal.

vision.description: Where the organization (or this site) wants to be at the horizon of the matrix.

name: set_strategic_context
title: Propose the strategic context
